Independent exact active-set enumeration of all C(18,6)=18564 bases yielded 4704 nonsingular candidates and 31 feasible vertices, 29 integral and 2 half-integral. Independent fourfold interval summation gave 14 parity interpolation counts from m=0..13 and direct 6D enumeration agreed for m≤3. Rational Ehrhart theorem bounds degree six and period dividing two, so seven samples per parity prove both polynomials for all m; nonzero branch difference 1/32 proves minimal period two. All values include labeled worlds, no symmetry or antisymmetry restrictions.
